verdict.rationale: Crossmint's core offering is a proprietary REST API/wallet platform gated by API keys and accounts (docs-21, requires client/server API keys), not an open, versioned specification developers can read and implement without signing anything. While Crossmint integrates with open protocols like x402 and MPP built by others, no evidence shows Crossmint publishing its own commerce protocol as an open spec, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404s across all candidate paths, indicating no publicly discoverable machine-readable spec.
